```yaml
name: Debug OCI Merge

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      target_branch:
        description: 'Target branch to merge into (default: main)'
        required: false
        default: 'main'
        type: choice
        options:
          - main
          - develop
      source_branch:
        description: 'Source branch to merge from (default: develop)'
        required: false
        default: 'develop'
        type: choice
        options:
          - main
          - develop

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  debug-merge:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Configure Git
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Fetch latest changes
        run: |
          git fetch origin

      - name: Merge develop into target
        env:
          TARGET_BRANCH: ${{ github.event.inputs.target_branch }}
          SOURCE_BRANCH: ${{ github.event.inputs.source_branch }}
        run: |
          echo "Merging $SOURCE_BRANCH into $TARGET_BRANCH"
          
          # Checkout target branch
          git checkout "$TARGET_BRANCH"
          
          # Pull latest changes
          git pull origin "$TARGET_BRANCH"
          
          # Merge source branch
          git merge "$SOURCE_BRANCH" --no-edit || {
            echo "Merge conflict detected. Aborting."
            exit 1
          }
          
          # Push changes
          git push origin "$TARGET_BRANCH"

      - name: Setup Ruby
        if: always()
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.2'
          bundler-cache: true

      - name: Setup Node.js
        if: always()
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install pnpm
        if: always()
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 8

      - name: Install dependencies
        if: always()
        run: |
          pnpm install

      - name: Run E2E Tests
        if: always()
        run: |
          pnpm run playwright

      - name: Run Tryouts
        if: always()
        run: |
          pnpm run test:tryouts:agent

      - name: Run Ruby Tests
        if: always()
        run: |
          bundle exec rake test

      - name: Upload Test Results
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: test-results
          path: |
            test-results/
            coverage/
          retention-days: 30
```
